description: How XP-GSI reads the scratchpad of the user's CDU/MCDU for arrival gate reservation (entries typed as G<stand>, e.g. GB12, on the ground). The first enabled adapter whose 'match' conditions all hold is used. 'read.dataref' must be a byte/string dataref; its text up to the first NUL is the scratchpad. A '{n}' in it reads lines 0..15 and uses the first line holding a G entry. The adapter chosen for an aircraft is logged in XP-GSI.log; a G entry naming no stand is logged as ignored. Changes take effect on the next aircraft load or plugin reload.

adapters.name: Zibo / LevelUp 737
adapters.note: Verified 2026-10-26 in LevelUp 737NG (a Zibo fork) plugins/xlua/scripts (B738.a_fms.lua, line 4340): create_dataref("laminar/B738/fmc1/Line_entry", "string"). Matched by that dataref existing, because Zibo and Laminar's 737 both use b738.acf.

adapters.name: ToLiss A319 / A320 / A321 / A340 / A346
adapters.note: MCDU 1 scratchpad (white text). NOT verified in the sim yet; matched only when the dataref exists, so a wrong name falls through to the default adapter.

adapters.name: X-Plane CDU (default aircraft; any add-on that mirrors its screen)
adapters.note: Dataref names verified in X-Plane 11 DataRefs.txt (fms_cdu1_text_line0..15, byte[96]). Which line is the scratchpad is not verified, so every line is read; only a line that is G plus an existing stand name reserves. Exists in every sim: the fallback for aircraft without their own adapter.
